residue.label: Session state contract unresolved

residue.next_action: Design one minimal session-state schema around objective, active question, answers, evidence, dispositions, residue, and next allowed or blocked action.

residue.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Language Runtime owner plus chat integration owner
residue.next_action: Validate serialized CLI and chat projections over the same Question View first; select a real chat transport only after that proof requires integration.

residue.label: Single-writer store frame expiry
residue.description: The Layer 0 store assumes one local process, one writer, and whole-snapshot replacement. It does not claim crash, power-loss, filesystem, distributed, or concurrent-writer durability.
residue.owner_route: selected CyberAlchemy v2 Language Runtime owner
residue.next_action: Re-distill the persistence and conflict model when a second independently running writer or asynchronous chat transport may mutate the same Session.
